summary: Managed harness drivers apply the install access mode, retain provider update availability, and show the active mode in doctor

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change. Active mode is an additive daemon.started feature; update availability uses existing harness.diagnostic fields.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: The optional config.toml access_mode key accepts auto and bypass; older builds reject it. Missing mode preserves bypass. New service configs write auto. Auto Codex uses a named workspace profile, networking and auto_review; bypass uses both dangerous bypass flags. Both modes default Codex hook trust bypass. Claude auto uses auto permissions; bypass skips permissions. Authored permission options remain authoritative. New seat/planner declarations omit those flags. Fresh and resumed Codex profile behavior is qualified with Codex 0.160.1 schema/probe evidence and isolated provider fixtures.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional interruption. Config mode changes take effect at daemon startup and affect subsequent seat launches; already-running providers retain their policy.

manual.detail: Existing configurations need no change. New setups write auto; Home Manager users can select accessMode explicitly. Provider updates remain Operations-owned.

recovery.detail: Before reverting to an older build, remove access_mode from config.toml and the corresponding Home Manager option. The missing key restores legacy bypass behavior; existing provider processes keep their launch permissions until restarted.
